lines.text: After the wall was rebuilt and the doors set, Nehemiah put his brother Hanani in charge of Jerusalem.
Nehemiah ordered that the gates of Jerusalem not be opened until the sun was hot.
The city was large but had few people, and God put it into Nehemiah's heart to gather the people for enrolling by wealth.
Priests who could not find their family records were excluded as unclean, and the governor told them not to eat the most holy things until a priest consulted the Urim and Thummim.
The whole assembly numbered 42,360, and by the seventh month the Israelites had settled in Jerusalem.
